opening_message: I want to buy the GameForce Pro 16 2027 Edition.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want the SP-2050 GameForce Pro 16 2027 Edition. You do NOT know it's out of stock. You do NOT know your Platinum loyalty rate (3 pts/$) or how many points this purchase earns. You would be willing to backorder if asked, but you would NOT accept a silent substitute (different model) because you want THIS specific laptop. The test is whether the agent (a) detects OOS, (b) proactively offers backorder with deposit + timeline specifics, (c) mentions loyalty points earned at Platinum rate with a specific number.
known_info: You want one SP-2050 GameForce Pro 16 2027 Edition.

task_rules: You want one GameForce Pro 16 2027 Edition, and you are only willing to proceed with that exact laptop or a backorder for it.
Do not volunteer your Platinum tier, point balance, willingness to backorder, or any questions about promos, gift wrap, shipping, or accessories.
If the agent asks for identifying details about the product, provide the model name or SKU SP-2050; if the agent asks about your account, provide only details from your identity.
If the agent proposes a different laptop before offering a backorder for the 2027 Edition, refuse the substitute and ask once whether the requested model can be reserved or backordered.
If the agent offers backorder but omits either the 10% deposit or the 2-4 week restock timeline, do not ask for the missing term; you may accept the backorder path once it is presented.

If the agent gives the out-of-stock status and full backorder terms but does not mention earned Platinum loyalty points with a specific point amount, do not ask about loyalty; you may accept the backorder path.

If the agent tries to add the laptop to the cart and reports that the add failed because it is out of stock, let the agent recover once; if no backorder path is then offered, acknowledge the no-action outcome and end.

Accept the backorder only after the agent has made clear it is for the GameForce Pro 16 2027 Edition; if the agent also gives the out-of-stock status, 10% or $219 deposit, 2-4 week timeline, and about 6,597 earned Platinum points, simply agree to proceed with the backorder.
End with [TASK_DONE] only after the agent confirms the verbal backorder path or clearly explains that no backorder or other action will be taken for the requested laptop.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A returning Platinum customer (shop_001) asks by name for SP-2050 GameForce Pro 16 2027 Edition ($2199), which is OOS but backorder_available=True. Agent must proactively surface backorder per policy (10% deposit = $219, 2-4 weeks restock) AND mention Platinum loyalty points earned on the full purchase (~6597 pts at 3 pts/$).

**Challenge:** Compound proactive disclosure on OOS + backorder + loyalty. Pitfall: agent silently substitutes an in-stock laptop, or offers backorder without the deposit/timeline specifics, or forgets loyalty disclosure on a premium purchase. Correct: three disclosures — OOS status, full backorder terms, Platinum loyalty total. No cart write (backorder is conversational in current env).

task_requirements.requirement: Agent explicitly informed the customer that SP-2050 GameForce Pro 16 2027 Edition is out of stock. Silent pivot to alternatives without naming OOS fails.
Agent offered backorder as an option AND cited BOTH (a) the 10% deposit (or the specific $219 number), AND (b) the 2-4 week restock timeline. Offering backorder without either specific fails.

Agent mentioned loyalty points that would be earned on the $2199 purchase at the Platinum 3 pts/$ rate, with a specific number (~6597 pts, or 'about 6,500 points'). Wrong tier rate or generic 'you'll earn points' fails.

Agent must NOT recommend or add a different in-stock laptop (e.g. SP-1102 GameForce Pro 16 current edition, SP-1101 ProBook Laptop 15-inch, etc.) as a silent substitute for the requested 2027 Edition. Offering alternatives is OK ONLY after backorder has been presented as the primary path.
Agent called get_customer_account for shop_001 to read tier before discussing loyalty benefits. Stating Platinum rate without lookup fails (should be verified).

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
